g.text: $ curl -s localhost:8000/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"question": "¿Qué productos
se venden mejor en Alemania que en España?"}' | jq '{status, retry_count, sql_history,
final_answer, latency_ms}'
"status": "success",
"retry_count": 1,
"sql_history": [
"SELECT p.sku, p.name AS product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.country = 'Germany' THEN oi.quantity ELSE
0 END) AS units_sold_germany, SUM(CASE WHEN o.country = 'Spain' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END)
AS units_sold_spain FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN
orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY
p.product_id, p.sku, p.name ORDER BY units_sold_germany DESC, units_sold_spain DESC",
"SELECT p.sku, p.name AS product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN oi.quantity ELSE
0 END) AS units_sold_germany, SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Spain' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END)
AS units_sold_spain FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN
orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE
o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.sku, p.name ORDER BY
units_sold_germany DESC, units_sold_spain DESC"
"final_answer": "Los productos que se venden mejor en Alemania son:\n1. DevStation Pro 16\n2.

StudioANC Wireless
3. ProBook Ultra 14
4. ClearMic USB Pod
5. TactilePro TKL",
"latency_ms": 13905.55
